primary.body:
## Summary

The pentest/ directory had a mix of real, runnable security tools and fake "simulation" stubs that hardcoded findings without ever testing the target. This PR removes the noise and keeps only what actually works.

## What was removed (noise / dead code)

- **`.github/workflows/strix-pentest.yml`** — called a non-existent CLI (`python -m pentest.scanner`) and would have errored at runtime
- **`pentest/scanner.py`'s 5 fake stubs** — `scan_sql_injection`, `scan_xss`, `scan_idor`, `scan_ssrf`, and `comprehensive_scan` all hardcoded fake "findings" without ever touching the target
- **`tools/pentest.py` registration of `comprehensive_scan`** — removed the fake tool from the registry (now 36 tools)

## What was fixed (broken / dishonest)

- **`pentest/cicd.py`** — the three YAML generators (`generate_github_actions_workflow`, `generate_gitlab_ci`, `generate_jenkinsfile`) emitted configs that referenced the non-existent `python -m pentest.scanner` CLI. Rewrote them to call the **real** `sast_scan` function and properly fail builds on real findings.
- **`pentest/bugbounty.py`** + **`pentest/multi_agent.py`** — both called the fake `comprehensive_scan`. Rerouted to the real `combined_sast_dast` (regex SAST + header DAST).
- **Marketing strings** in `pentest/reporting.py`, `pentest/viewer.py`, `tools/pentest.py`, `README.md`, `SIMPLE_GUIDE.md` — cleaned up text referencing the non-existent `strix view` / `strix --target` CLI commands. Updated example invocations.

## What was kept (real, runnable code)

- `vuln_kb.py` — KB data + search
- `recon.py` — sublist3r + HTTP fingerprinting
- `sast_dast.py` — regex SAST + header DAST
- `reporting.py` — file-based run/finding/report management
- `viewer.py` — local HTTP server with tokened link
- `cicd.py` — YAML generators (now fixed)
- `bugbounty.py`, `compliance.py`, `continuous_learning.py`, `devsecops.py`, `multi_agent.py`
- `scanner.py` — now reduced to a single real function: `scan_api_spec` (parses OpenAPI/Swagger/Postman)
- `tools/pentest.py` — 36 real tools

## Note

Legal attribution to the original Strix project is preserved in the `README.md` Disclaimer section.

## Stats

11 files changed, 126 insertions(+), 349 deletions(-) — net -223 lines of noise.
